title: Sheet-metal manufacturability checks
summary: Typed DFM query over the sheet-metal model against a shop profile — surfaced live in the sheet-metal panel as a Problems-style inspector.
details:
## What's New

- **`check_manufacturability(model, shop)`** in `vcad-kernel-sheet`: a pure function returning structured `Violation`s — `BendRadiusBelowMinimum`, `BendExceedsBrakeCapacity`, `FlangeBelowMinHeight`, `HoleTooCloseToBend`, `BendsTooClose` — each with the ids and measured-vs-required numbers a fix needs.
- **`ShopProfile`** type with a sensible `generic()` default (3 m brake, R/t ≥ 1, 5 mm min flange, hole/bend clearances) so the inspector is useful before a shop is configured.
- Threaded through the WASM binding and engine glue alongside the flat pattern.
- **DFM inspector** in the sheet-metal panel: a `0 errors · 1 warning` chip that reads "Shop-ready" when clean, with severity-dotted rows.

This is the first leg of the spec's DFM-as-typed-query — the same data will back the `sheet_metal.check` MCP tool.
